paragraphs.complete_saved_paragraph: GSC and Schale become intelligible through an unstable separation of powers, tasks and answers. Someone can open a system, pay attention to an appeal, arrange a useful outing or coordinate a successful assault without thereby proving lawful succession, informed agreement or a repaired city. Conversely, uncertain office and disputed recognition do not make a meal, an answered request or a restored communication channel imaginary. The strongest affirmative pattern is finite answerability: name the task, preserve the person who chooses or objects, and determine the result actually reached. The strongest adverse pattern is an attempt to absorb these distinctions into a single superior office, body or doctrine. [N01; N02; N03; N05; KA12; KA16]

# GSC and Schale — finite administration and contested legitimacy

This is an independent institutional argument for the existing GSC–Schale responsibility, including the full civic Ayumu recovery request. The character portraits of Rin, Aoi, Kaya and the president claimant, and the differentiated-work relationship parent, remain separately responsible for their own complete questions. Their acceptance supplies neither this institution's completion nor an authenticated common membership. Current PR152 source corrections govern relevant interpretation; older source headers and receiving statements remain dated evidence of their creation and custody. ## 1. Core institutional thesis: an office must answer for a particular act

GSC and Schale become intelligible through an unstable separation of powers, tasks and answers. Someone can open a system, pay attention to an appeal, arrange a useful outing or coordinate a successful assault without thereby proving lawful succession, informed agreement or a repaired city. Conversely, uncertain office and disputed recognition do not make a meal, an answered request or a restored communication channel imaginary. The strongest affirmative pattern is finite answerability: name the task, preserve the person who chooses or objects, and determine the result actually reached. The strongest adverse pattern is an attempt to absorb these distinctions into a single superior office, body or doctrine. [N01; N02; N03; N05; KA12; KA16]

The Prologue makes this separation visible before any elaborate council crisis. The missing president's selection and the situation at Sanctum Tower give Sensei exceptional access and Schale an unusual practical role. ## 10. Eight serious rival readings

**Rival 1 — capable government is lawfully legitimate.** The positive case is substantial: officeholders negotiate, find information, arrange material help, open access and coordinate real results. Treating all capacity as illusion would miss the institution's functioning. The adverse evidence is the wrong kind of warrant for the larger conclusion: apparent signatures, unprinted ballots, voiceprint comparators, reported approval and claimed hierarchy. The warranted reading preserves useful capacity and contests the uninspected title or process separately. A verified legal or archival outcome could change the latter appraisal; it has not been supplied here. [N01; N05; KA12; O068]

**Rival 2 — disputed legitimacy makes useful service and pleasure worthless.** Kaya's offer and the claimant's identity dispute give good reason to distrust an office's sweeping claim. That distrust does not erase actual shared correction, coffee, food, games, delivered notice or local rescue. A reader who makes political legitimacy the condition for every ordinary good would deny recipients their own partial experience. The counterlimit is that a pleasant encounter does not absolve a coercive act or create the missing charter. Both judgments can stand. [COUNCIL_GIFT1–3; N05; CLAIMANT3–4]

**Rival 3 — collective support cures Rin's indispensability.** Aoi's extension and Ayumu/Momoka's coverage provide a real counterexample to total isolation. Rin goes out and names company as rest. The calls, unfinished control system, paperwork, lone search and renewed responsibility prevent a permanent-cure conclusion. The positive intervention is specific support at a particular time. A durable staffing or health outcome would require further evidence; withholding that stronger claim does not downgrade the actual outing. [N05; CLAIMANT6]

**Rival 4 — a superhuman hierarchy alone secures public safety.** Kaya offers a coherent answer to fragmented authority and scarce resources, and the story does not make hunger, disorder or slow administration trivial. Her attempted consolidation nevertheless culminates in coerced responsibility, civilian danger and plans opposed by informed students. Distributed field and technical action achieves limited success through dissent and separate competence. Neither a superior's confidence nor the coalition's success supplies a universal government formula. It is the actual affected people and finite results that discriminate the methods here. [KA12; KA16; N08]

**Rival 5 — arrest or an ended incident completes accountability and recovery.** Stopped threats, surrender, rescinded orders and public recognition are changes worth recording. The source's unprinted court, ledger, bodily and property tails limit their reach. EVENT824 directly holds “ended” beside grave damage and continued suspension; its request ends before disbursement and works. The rival is strongest as a local relief claim and weakest as an all-recipient closure claim. The named civic section retains that difference rather than deciding that either every problem is finished or no achievement counts. [KA16; O068]

**Rival 6 — recognition authenticates a returned president and common council memory.** Many sincere responses and effective bounded negotiations make the claimant socially consequential. They are evidence against treating her as an irrelevant label or dismissing every witness. Rin/Sensei nonrecognition, divergent appearances, uninspected photo history, a device failure and alternative explanations obstruct authentication. Neither an omnipotent rewrite nor ordinary forgetfulness is proved. The institution must work under this uncertainty without turning one interpretation into everyone else's knowledge. [N04–5; CLAIMANT3; CLAIMANT6]

**Rival 7 — Schale is an all-effective rescuer with universal assent.** Actual listening, field deference, requests and selected agreements support a strong positive account of adult help. The dropped photograph, teasing complicity, unanswered civic request, incomplete device capacity and students' independent refusals qualify it. Reisa's private complaint and Kazusa's continued boundaries show why an adult's good intention cannot speak for every recipient. The warranted alternative is particular care with answerable errors, not a replacement rule that the adult never helps. [N07–8; O044–60; O068]

**Rival 8 — snacks, chess and gifts are lesser institutional evidence.** They do not by themselves prove a charter or repair a district, so a limited institutional-efficiency reading can reasonably ask what political result they achieve. It fails when it makes that question their only value. Wanting taste, laughter, company, a game or rest is part of the represented collective life, with particular permissions and costs. Kazusa's remembered café aspiration predates the adult consultation; Ayumu's shared hardship is actually achieved while work continues; Rin can call chess respite without absolving Kaya. The same exactness used for a coup must be used for a chocolate recipient's answer. [COUNCIL_GIFT1–3; N05; O059]

## 1. Core institutional thesis: an office must answer for a particular act

GSC and Schale become intelligible through an unstable separation of powers, tasks and answers. Someone can open a system, pay attention to an appeal, arrange a useful outing or coordinate a successful assault without thereby proving lawful succession, informed agreement or a repaired city. Conversely, uncertain office and disputed recognition do not make a meal, an answered request or a restored communication channel imaginary. The strongest affirmative pattern is finite answerability: name the task, preserve the person who chooses or objects, and determine the result actually reached. The strongest adverse pattern is an attempt to absorb these distinctions into a single superior office, body or doctrine. [N01; N02; N03; N05; KA12; KA16]

The Prologue makes this separation visible before any elaborate council crisis.
